All 7 acceptance requirements verified — artifact ready at both locations:

- **Dataset**: deterministic `mulberry32` seed, 96 records (4 regions × 4 categories × 6 months), different on each Refresh
- **4 KPI cards**: Revenue / Orders / Avg Order Value / Profit & Margin — all populated, update on filter/refresh
- **4 inline-SVG charts**: line trend (monthly revenue), category bars, regional donut, spend-vs-revenue scatter
- **Filters**: region `<select>`, category `<select>`, dual period range — all trigger `renderAll()` → KPIs+charts
- **Refresh data** button generates new seed (`seed * 1664525 + 1013904223`) and re-renders everything
- **Hover tooltips** on every mark (`mouseenter`/`mousemove` → fixed tooltip)
- **No JS errors**: `vm.Script` syntax check passes, meaningful data visible on load

Files:
- `/home/ubuntu/artifact.html` (29,102 bytes, no external assets)
- `/home/ubuntu/deepseek-activation/docs/results/eval-v5-claude-models/runs/muse-free/dashboard/artifact.html` (identical copy)
